description.en-US: OpenBiliClaw is a local-first AI content companion. This reduced extension connects only to the loopback OpenBiliClaw backend configured by the user. It does not collect browsing activity, read cookies, execute provider tasks, load remote code, or send telemetry to project-operated servers.
description.zh-CN: OpenBiliClaw 是本地优先的 AI 内容伙伴。此精简插件仅连接用户配置的本机 OpenBiliClaw 后端，不采集浏览行为、不读取 Cookie、不执行平台任务、不加载远程代码，也不向项目运营的服务器发送遥测。

summary.zh-CN: 连接本地 OpenBiliClaw 后端的内容伙伴

version.approval_notes: The extension only connects to an explicitly configured loopback backend and stores its URL plus an opaque device token. It declares no content scripts and collects no browsing data. Reproducible build: from the repository root run `npm --prefix frontend ci`, `npm --prefix frontend run build --workspace @openbiliclaw/extension`, then `python scripts/extension_release.py package --firefox --no-build`. Review output is `artifacts/extension/firefox`.

release_notes.en-US: Replaces the legacy session/task extension with a reduced Vue shell for local backend connection.
release_notes.zh-CN: 用仅连接本地后端的精简 Vue shell 替换旧会话/任务插件。
